start_here: Say to your AI: "Switch on workflow:find-workflows-that-can-never-fire with credential_name <the vault name of my own account database>." It then checks every workflow condition each day and each time a workflow row changes.
no_lists_because: The sweep reads the workflow rows the person's database already keeps and writes its findings as calendar tasks there; no list of the person's is needed.
instructions: 1. Name the vault connection of the database your workflow rows are kept in (credential_name).
2. Switch the daily wake on for workflow:find-workflows-that-can-never-fire with that name as the switch input.
3. The run counts the conditions it cannot judge, opens one calendar task per problem and closes the fixed ones, then answers three counts only.
4. Read the open findings in your calendar tasks, labelled finding and never-fire.

worked_examples.title: Check every workflow condition once
worked_examples.ask: Run workflow:find-workflows-that-can-never-fire with credential_name for my database now
worked_examples.answer: Three counts: opened, closed_now and problems_now.
worked_examples.hands_back: Three counts, for example {"opened":0,"closed_now":0,"problems_now":0} when nothing new is unjudgeable.
